provenance.pcm: LookupPcmPlaybackConfig iterates 12 native playback configurations until the zero identifier sentinel. The complete 13-record SoundEntry array ends at the independently indexed staff-roll Sprite table. Each record contains identifier, sample count and playback rate, consumed with their existing canonical field widths. All 156 bytes are identical in US, JP and EU; there are no resource payload bytes or fabricated padding objects.
provenance.pcm_owner: The five consecutive PCM playback functions follow the decoded-buffer API and precede the separate audio block codec in every original region. Their two counters and two 704-byte output buffers have no other source consumers; every aligned ROM reference to these states occurs within this function run. Ordinary private state declarations produce an eight-byte-aligned BSS section, explaining the four-byte gap after the decoded stream state without gUnk_0203809C, a placeholder introduced in 986d6838 without an earlier ledger entry. The unchanged playback table is native readonly data in this bounded PCM owner. The remaining staff-roll, text, DMA and block-stream boundaries are not inferred from this split.
